  Application firmware version: 52

CLI HELP (USB CDC)
The same commands are available on USB CDC, BLE and Cloud CLI.
Keys: Tab=complete, Up/Down=history, Ctrl-C=cancel.

General:
  help | menu | ?
  version
  status
  usb status
  clear

Sensor and AI:
  MAP ON | MAP OFF               ToF stream; dedicated image channel on BLE/Cloud
  MAP CHANNELS [1..5]            list/toggle channels
  MAP ENCODING                   show wireless image compression
  MAP ENCODING RAW|UINT16|UINT8|JPEG
                                 BLE/Cloud only; JPEG lossy; USB unchanged
  tof status|pause|resume
  DATASET STREAM ON|OFF|STATUS
  RPS ON|OFF|STATUS

Map processing (USB+BLE+Cloud):
  MAP PROCESSING                       list filters/values/ranges
  MAP PROCESSING OFF|BOX|MEDIAN|GAUSSIAN|SHARPEN|MIN|MAX
  MAP PROCESSING OBJECT 1..7 | NPU    stages or exact NPU input
  MAP PROCESSING <filter> <value>      single-parameter form
  MAP PROCESSING <filter> <parameter> <value>
  Parameters: BOX radius/passes; MEDIAN radius/threshold_mm;
              GAUSSIAN radius/passes; SHARPEN radius/amount_percent;
              MIN/MAX radius; OBJECT 7 threshold.

Radio and Wi-Fi:
  debug off|error|warn|info|debug
  DEMO MAP ON 1|2 [CLOUD|BLE]   timed moving-pixel source; DEMO MAP OFF/STATUS
  debug ping <token>           transport-only latency probe
  debug route                  session generations + M2 isolation diagnostic
  debug uart                   asynchronous UART counters
  debug uart burst             emit 100 ordered UART test lines
  debug uart overflow          force bounded-queue drops; never stall
  radio hardware|status|info
  wifi status | wifi ip         link/DHCP addresses
  wifi scan                     scan <=15 networks
  wifi connect "SSID"          hidden password + DHCP
  wifi disconnect [forget]      optionally erase credentials

Cloud CLI via http Relay:
  cloud status | cloud endpoint
  cloud pair <6-digit-code>     available from USB or BLE
  cloud prepare yes            USB: approved RAM transition candidate
  cloud enable | cloud disable
  cloud reconnect | cloud test
  cloud unpair yes              delete the saved device token
  CLI text/XMODEM and ToF use independent Cloud channels.

BLE, update and reset:
  ble status                   GATT/link/MTU/queues
  ble adv on | ble adv off
  ble disconnect
  BLE modes: CLI RX=Write, CLI TX=Notify; ToF image=dedicated Notify.

  BLE ToF pixels stay on the dedicated ToF-image CCCD.
  update                       signed XMODEM firmware update
  reboot yes
  W arm | W | W cancel         local USB CLI task hang/reset diagnostic
  UART: w then W within5s; s then W tests supervisor
